checks: Authenticated Admin permission is independent of display name; an ordinary author and a guest displayed as Admin receive HTTP 403 for somebody else’s circuit.
Owner publishes and deletes from the UI; Escape cancels, keyboard focus stays in confirmation, catalogue/selection update immediately, and the preserved draft republishes with a new identity.
A different client removes the selected circuit while the picker is open; Refresh removes its preview and restores an official choice, and reopening the editor preserves and detaches the local draft.
A real concurrent v2 update rejects confirmation of v1 with HTTP 409; the circuit and draft survive until an explicit refresh and a new confirmation.
Simulated permission-change 403 and real expired-session 401 remain readable, preserve the drawing and circuit, and cannot execute a stale-authority deletion.
Real logout/login on the same page removes Admin controls for Bob and restores them for Admin; both accounts keep independent local drawings.
The authenticated Admin account, displayed as Prof de la classe, removes Bob’s circuit with explicit name/author confirmation while preserving its own draft and the historical revision.
Mobile 320×568: a long circuit name fits the confirmation, both actions stay visible with 44 px targets, touch Cancel preserves the circuit and touch Delete removes it without horizontal overflow.

evidence.scope: Built client and real private server; disposable accounts and circuits. Desktop Chromium and mobile touch emulation.
limitations: No physical phone or Safari iOS tested.
Running races and replay persistence are covered separately by server tests.
